Chocolate Love Cakes
By: Marybeth
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:05pm

Ingredients




6 ounces Bittersweet Chocolate (Ghirardelli)
2 ounces –  Semisweet Chocolate (Ghirardelli)
10 Tbs. - Butter
cup ½  - Flour
1 cup ½  - Powder Sugar
3 Large Eggs
3 Egg Yolks
1 teaspoon - Vanilla
2 Tbs. - Orange Extract
 cup - Mini Chocolate Chips
Heart Shaped Candy

Chocolate Whipped Topping

Preparation

1 Grease 6 (6 oz.) cups, melt the chocolate and butter in the microwave. After melted stir in the flour and sugar then mix in the eggs and yolk until smooth. Stir in the mini chips, vanilla and orange extract. Divide the mixture evenly between the 6 cups and bake for 12-14 minutes at 425 degrees. The edges of the cakes should be firm while the center is still soft and gooey. Run a butter knife around the edges of the cakes to loosen. Drizzle your serving plate with some chocolate syrup; place a love cake on top then frost it with some whip topping and place a candy heart in the center. Your special someone will really feel the love you put into these cute little cakes.

About



I wanted to surprise my husband with an extra special early Valentines dessert tonight, I knew that whatever I was going to make it had to be chocolate, not just because it is my favorite thing in the whole world..next to my husband but because something homemade from chocolate is just so sexy, alluring and is a huge aphrodisiac. I had been thinking about this for weeks now and finally decided on chocolate cake, they are so chocolaty, rich and gooey, the perfect pre-valentines dessert.
